Which Mia product became which AI creative

Every AI image and video we made for the Lightscapes Pink Spectrum site, traced back to its source. Drag any image to compare the original with what AI produced, and use the product code to find it on miabytanishq.com.

Made from a Mia product

Four products. The original catalogue photo is the input, so the SKU is confirmed.

 Concept, no Mia product

Six pieces generated from a design mockup. They show the visual direction and are not in the Mia catalogue.

Concept pieces, not Mia products

These six creatives were rendered from small product sketches inside the Pink Spectrum design mockup, shown on the right. Each sketch is lined up with its render so you can compare them directly. They are not photos of Mia stock.

We checked all of them against about 1,070 live Mia listings: every ring, pendant, necklace, bracelet, bangle and coin, plus the full Lightscapes collection. None is a match.

The names on the Pink Spectrum site, such as Petal Glow Ring or Bloom Bangle, belong to the mockup. Before this site goes live, each one should be swapped for a real Mia SKU, or regenerated from that SKU’s catalogue photo.

Not part of this list

The Lightscapes earring and ring key visuals, and the Aneet campaign portraits, were supplied by Mia’s agency. We only removed text and resized them for the web, so they are not AI creatives.

The jhumkas in the earring key visual are the Radiant Cascading Diamond Jhumka (553126JMEAFA09).
